title: SEO AEO AI SEO GEO Specialist
description:
We are seeking a seasoned SEO AEO GEO AI SEO Specialist to join our team. This role demands demonstrated experience, a data-driven approach, and the ability to leverage AI tools to optimize both traditional and emerging search experiences.



About the Role

Position**: SEO AEO AI SEO Specialist

Department**: Marketing / Growth

Location**: Remote or on-site (flexible)

Employment Type**: Full-time

Experience Level**: Senior/Lead with verifiable results



What You’ll Do

Strategy Development**: Create and execute comprehensive SEO and AEO (AI-Enhanced Optimization) strategies that improve organic visibility, featured snippets, and voice/search results across traditional and AI-powered channels.

  Develop roadmaps for on-page, technical, and off-page SEO with an AI-centric focus.

  Integrate AI-driven insights to anticipate user intent and optimize for voice, visual, and chat-based search experiences.

GMB/Local SEO Management**: Optimize Google My Business (GMB) profiles to improve local rankings, reviews, and engagement.

  Monitor local presence, citations, and NAP consistency.

  Align local content and events with overall SEO strategy.

AI Tools & Automation**: Implement and manage AI platforms (e.g., ChatGPT-based workflows, AI-assisted content generation, and voice-search optimization tools).

  Build and refine prompts, workflows, and dashboards to streamline SEO activities.

  Explore and pilot new AI-driven ranking signals and ranking-tracking methodologies.

Content Optimization**: Guide content teams on AI-assisted content creation, semantic optimization, and structured data.

  Ensure consistency with brand voice while leveraging AI to scale quality.

Analytics & Reporting**: Measure performance, run experiments, and report on key metrics (traffic, rankings, conversions, LTV, and ROI).

  Use AI-powered analytics to derive actionable insights and optimize campaigns.

Collaboration & Leadership**: Partner with product, engineering, and marketing teams to implement technical SEO improvements and ensure scalable AI integration.

  Mentor junior tea
mbers and share best practices in AI-enhanced SEO.



What We’re Looking For

Experience-Driven**: A proven track record in delivering tangible SEO results, with measurable improvements in rankings, traffic, and conversions.

GMB/Local Expertise**: Demonstrated success optimizing Google My Business profiles and local search presence.

AI Proficiency**: Strong familiarity with AI tools and workflows (e.g., ChatGPT or equivalent) for SEO tasks, content ideation, and voice/search optimization.

Technical Skills**: Solid understanding of technical SEO, schema markup, site speed, crawlability, indexation, and tooling (GA4, Search Console, log file analysis, rank trackers).

Strategic Mindset**: Ability to balance short-term wins with long-term growth, experimentation, and data-driven decision-making.

Communication**: Clear, collaborative communicator who can translate complex concepts to non-technical stakeholders and guide cross-functional teams.



Preferred Qualifications

Certifications in SEO, local SEO, or analytics.

Experience with multi-channel SEO, including voice search, visual search, and AI-assisted content.

Familiarity with competitive analysis, backlink strategy, and content marketing alignment.



Compensation & Benefits

Salary**: Competitive, with a premium offering after a successful trial period based on demonstrated impact.

Trial Period**: A clearly defined initial trial period during which you will demonstrate practical SEO capabilities and provide tangible examples of results (including work on GMB and AI-enhanced initiatives).

Performance Review**: Premium compensation awarded upon meeting or exceeding agreed Uplift milestones.

Benefits**: Comprehensive health/dental/vision coverage, retirement benefits, paid time off, flexible work arrangements, ongoing learning budget.



What to Expect During the Hiring Process

Portfolio or case studies showing prior SEO and local optimization results.

Examples of campaigns that utilized AI tools for SEO tasks.

A practical assessment or task related to optimizing a GMB profile and a sample AI-driven content plan.

Behavioral and technical interviews to assess fit and communication skills.



How to Apply

Please submit:

  Your resume highlighting relevant SEO and local optimization achievements.

  Case studies or links to campaigns with measurable outcomes.

  A short description of how you have used AI tools to improve SEO results, including any successful experiments in voice or AI-assisted content.



If you’re a results-oriented SEO professional with a strong background in local optimization and AI-enabled strategies, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today to join a dynamic team that values experience, innovation, and measurable impact.

title: Personal Research & Executive Support Assistant
description:
## Overview



I'm a busy professional and father based in Portugal. I need a sharp, AI-powered research assistant who can take a brief and come back with organized, actionable options.



This is not a virtual receptionist role. This is research, sourcing, coordination, and organization across personal life projects — property renovation, education planning, health, travel, and more.



## AI Is Central to This Role



I use AI extensively and I expect you to as well — ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, or whatever makes you fastest. The best person for this role is someone who already uses AI tools daily and understands how to get great results from them.



**What great looks like:**

- You use AI to find leads faster, compare options, and draft clear summaries

- You know which tool works best for which task

- You verify everything AI gives you — every link works, every supplier is real, every price is current

- Your output is AI-accelerated but human-verified. Speed AND accuracy



The difference between good and great in this role is judgment. AI can find 50 results in seconds. Your job is to verify the best 5 and present them clearly.



In your application, tell me which AI tools you use and how they fit into your workflow. I'm genuinely interested in how you work.



## What You'll Actually Do



**Research & Sourcing (Primary — ~60% of time)**

- Product sourcing: building materials, tiles, fixtures, equipment, furniture — find suppliers, compare pricing, compile options with photos and links

- Service provider research: find specialists, coaches, practitioners across multiple domains. Compile profiles, availability, pricing, contact details

- Education research: homeschooling resources, curricula, programs, activities for a young child

- Travel logistics: flights, accommodation, itineraries, visa requirements

- Health & wellness: research practitioners, equipment, suppliers (natural/holistic focus)

- General: anything I need investigated, compared, or compiled



**Organization & Coordination (~25% of time)**

- Maintain organized research files and shared documents

- Follow up with vendors/contacts on my behalf (English-language)

- Schedule coordination (not calendar management — more like "find 3 available slots with this person")

- Track project progress and outstanding items

- Compile weekly summary of open tasks and findings



**Ad-Hoc Support (~15% of time)**

- Surprise tasks that don't fit a category

- "Can you find out..." questions that need digging

- Price monitoring on specific items

- Booking confirmations, reservation management





## What I'm Looking For



**Must have:**

- Excellent English (written and spoken)

- Daily AI user — you already use AI tools as part of your workflow, not experimenting with them

- Strong research skills — you know how to dig deep, cross-reference, and verify

- Self-directed. I give you a brief, you come back with results. You don't wait for step-by-step instructions

- Organized. Your output is clean — tables, links, photos, pricing, contact details. Not a wall of text

- Reliable. You hit deadlines. If something is going to be late, you tell me before it's due, not after

- Available during European morning hours (CET/WEST — Portugal is GMT+0/+1). Core overlap needed: 08:00-12:00 Lisbon time

- Comfortable working independently

- Meetings will happen daily at the beginning to share context and get started.



**Nice to have:**

- Experience supporting someone in a personal (non-corporate) capacity

- Familiarity with European suppliers and shipping

- Interest in health, wellness, natural living, or property renovation (you'll be researching these constantly)

- Basic Portuguese or Spanish (helpful for reading supplier websites, not required)



**Personality fit:**

- High agency. You see a problem, you solve it. You don't flag it and wait

- Low drama. Professional, clear communication

- Hungry. You take pride in delivering excellent work, not just completing tasks

- Honest. If you can't find something, say so. Don't pad results to look productive



## Hours & Compensation



- **Full-time: 40 hours/week** (Monday-Friday)

- **Schedule:** work your own hours but core overlap 08:00-12:00 Lisbon time required

- **Rate:** Competitive for experience level — please include your expected monthly rate

- **Tools:** Google Workspace, AI tools, messaging app (Slack/Signal/whatsapp), task management tool (Notion)

- **Payment:** Bi-weekly, via Wise or equivalent



## How to Apply



**Step 1:** Send me a brief message covering: (please create a loom video addressing me by name)

1. Your relevant experience (keep it to 3-4 sentences)

2. Why this role appeals to you specifically

3. Which AI tools you use daily and how they fit into your research workflow (be specific)

4. Your expected monthly rate for full-time (40 hours/week)



---



*I respond to every serious application. If you put in the effort on the test task, you'll hear back within 48 hours.*

title: AI Video Creator & Short-Form Editor for TikTok/Reels Ads
description:
We are building **Kreo AI**, a new AI image and video generation mobile app.



Kreo AI helps users create AI videos, AI images, photo-to-video effects, AI dance videos, image edits, and viral social media content.



We are looking for a creative **AI Video Creator & Short-Form Editor** who can generate high-quality AI image/video assets and turn them into jaw-dropping short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Meta ads, and TikTok ads.



This is not a general VA role. This role is focused on **AI content creation, short-form editing, and ad creative production**.



## Main Goal of the Role



Your main job is to create high-quality short-form video creatives using AI-generated assets.



You should be able to:



1. Generate AI images/videos using AI tools

2. Create strong visual concepts

3. Edit the assets into TikTok/Reels-style videos

4. Add hooks, captions, text overlays, music, and CTA

5. Create multiple creative variations for testing



We want videos that feel viral, modern, fast-paced, and suitable for TikTok/Reels/Meta ads.



## Responsibilities



### 1. AI Image & Video Asset Creation



You will create AI-generated assets for Kreo AI content and ads.



Examples:



* AI photo-to-video transformations

* AI dance/motion effects

* Cinematic AI videos

* AI portrait transformations

* AI image edits

* Before/after transformation assets

* App-style result demos

* Viral AI effect examples

* AI-generated visuals for ad creatives



Preferred AI tools:



* Kling

* Runway

* Seadance

* Google Veo

* Higgsfield

* ChatGPT / Claude for prompts



You do not need to know every tool, but you should be comfortable learning and testing AI tools quickly.



---



### 2. Short-Form Video Editing



You will turn AI assets into high-quality 9:16 videos for:



* TikTok

* Instagram Reels

* YouTube Shorts

* Meta Ads

* TikTok Ads



Editing should include:



* strong hook in the first 1–2 seconds

* fast pacing

* before/after reveal

* text overlays

* captions

* clean transitions

* music/sound effects

* result-first edits

* CTA ending

* mobile-first format



---



### 3. Ad Creative Production



You will create ad-style videos that can be tested on Meta and TikTok.



Example ad concepts:



* “One photo became this AI video”

* “AI turned my selfie into a movie scene”

* “Upload photo ? choose effect ? get result”

* “AI made my photo dance”

* “This is what AI can do with one image”

* “Create AI photos and turn them into videos”



The videos should be clear, exciting, and easy to understand even without sound.



---



### 4. Creative Variations



You will create multiple versions of the same concept for testing.



For example:



* different hooks

* different first 2 seconds

* different captions

* different thumbnail/cover text

* different CTA

* different music/sound

* different pacing

* different AI result examples



We are not looking for one single video only. We need someone who can create many testable creative variations.



---



### 5. Reference-Based Editing



We may provide reference videos or competitor ad examples.



Your job is to understand the structure and create an original Kreo version.



Important: We do not want to copy other brands exactly. We want to use inspiration and create original content for Kreo AI.



---



## Required Skills



* Strong short-form video editing skills

* Experience editing TikTok/Reels/Shorts

* Experience with CapCut or similar editing tools

* Good sense of pacing, hooks, and retention

* Ability to create before/after transformation videos

* Ability to add clean text overlays and captions

* Ability to create ad-style videos

* Ability to follow creative references

* Ability to generate or work with AI image/video assets

* Good communication

* Organized file delivery

* Ability to meet deadlines



---



## Nice-to-Have Skills



* Experience with AI video tools like Kling, Runway, Seadance, Veo, or Higgsfield

* Experience with AI image tools like Midjourney, DALL·E, or Leonardo

* Experience creating Meta ads or TikTok ads

* Experience with UGC-style ad creatives

* Experience promoting apps or SaaS products

* Experience with Premiere Pro / After Effects

* Experience writing hooks and captions

* Experience researching competitor ads



---



## Tools



Preferred tools:



* CapCut

* Canva

* Adobe Premiere Pro

* After Effects

* Photoshop

* Google Drive

* Google Sheets

* Notion



AI tools that are useful:



* Kling

* Runway

* Google Veo

* Higgsfield

* Seadance

* ChatGPT

* Claude



---



## Work Arrangement



This can start as a paid trial or part-time role.



If the quality is strong, this can become a long-term role.



Please include your expected rate for:



1. Part-time monthly work (4-5 hours/Day)

2. Full-time monthly work (8 hours/Day)



---



## Paid Trial Task



Before hiring long term, selected candidates will complete a paid trial.



For the trial, we will provide:



* one reference video format

* one AI photo/video concept

* basic brand direction for Kreo AI



Your task:



1. Create one 10–15 second vertical ad creative

2. Generate or prepare the AI visual/video asset

3. Add a strong hook in the first 1–2 seconds

4. Use fast pacing and clean captions

5. Show before/after or result reveal clearly

6. Add a CTA at the end

7. Provide 3 alternative hook options

8. Provide 3 thumbnail/cover text options

9. Explain which tools you used



The final video should feel suitable for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Meta Ads, and TikTok Ads.



---



## Example Creative Direction



Example concept:



**Normal photo ? AI cinematic video transformation**



Possible structure:



1. Show final AI result first for 1 second

2. Show original photo

3. Show “AI generating” or quick transition

4. Reveal the AI video result

5. Add CTA: “Try Kreo AI” / “Join early access”



---



## Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



* creative

* fast

* detail-oriented

* strong at short-form editing

* interested in AI content

* able to create high-quality visual results

* comfortable experimenting with AI tools

* able to create multiple ad variations

* able to follow instructions and improve based on feedback



We are not looking for basic admin support. We are looking for someone who can help create high-quality AI video ads and viral short-form content.



---



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your portfolio link

2. 3 best short-form videos you edited

3. Any AI-generated videos/images you created

4. Any ad creatives you edited

5. Tools you use for AI generation and editing

6. Your expected rate per video

7. Your expected monthly rate for part-time work

8. Your expected monthly rate for full-time work

9. Answer this question:



“If you were creating an ad for an AI photo-to-video app, how would you structure the first 5 seconds?”



Applications without portfolio or sample videos may not be considered.

title: Phone Sales & Customer Onboarding Specialist
description:
Time for Tutoring is a Sydney-based tutoring agency that connects Muslim families with qualified tutors. Our brand is built around and trusted by the Muslim community. The vast majority of our customers are Muslim families, and cultural understanding is at the heart of how we operate.

We are looking for someone to handle inbound enquiries, onboard new customers, and maintain ongoing relationships with families over the phone as we scale. We are a business that works 7 days a week and customer outreach is also completed on weekends.



What you'll be doing:



Speaking with warm leads who have already expressed interest in our service and guiding them through to becoming a customer

Calling parents first to gather key information so our team can match them with the right tutor

Explaining our service and pricing clearly and confidently

Handling objections with skill and composure. Parents will push back on price, ask hard questions, and need convincing. Your ability to handle this naturally and without being pushy is one of the most important parts of this role

Being the main point of contact for families after onboarding, maintaining the relationship, checking in, and resolving any concerns that come up

Following up with leads who have not yet committed

Light admin to keep things organised



Who we're looking for:



Excellent spoken English. This is a phone-heavy role with Australian customers and how you come across on a call is everything

A genuine understanding of Islamic culture, Muslim family life, and Muslim values. You do not just know about it, you get it

Warm, confident, and natural on the phone

Proven ability to handle objections and close without being pushy

Someone who builds trust easily and can maintain long term relationships with families

Previous sales, customer service, or phone-based experience required

A requirement of the role is to have a flexible availability as call volume varies day to day. A responsive and reachable individual is needed for this role. The nature of the role involves frequent communications with the team at various times within reason.



This role is not the right fit if you are not familiar with Muslim culture and the expectations of Muslim families.

To apply you must include:



A 60-second voice recording where you introduce yourself and then respond to this scenario: "A parent calls and asks if we can guarantee results. What do you say?"

A brief description of any phone-based or sales experience you have

Answer this question: How familiar are you with Islamic culture and Muslim communities, and where does that familiarity come from?



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered. Please do not read an ai scripted response. We appreciate genuine human responses.



This is a part-time role with flexible hours. Pay is a base rate of $5 to $10 AUD per hour plus commission per successful onboarding. The more you convert, the more you earn. There is real room to grow with the business as we scale.

title: Outbound Setter — Canadian Healthcare SaaS | Full-Time | $7/hr + $50/Zoom + $250/Sale
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

DoctorFlow is a healthcare technology company in Windsor, Ontario, Canada. Our founder, Dr. Bart Kaczmarek, is a practicing family physician who built a system that helps busy clinics see more patients without adding staff. It's now installed in 6 clinics across Ontario, growing through word-of-mouth.

We are not a call center or agency. We are founder-led product company. You report directly to the founder.



THE ROLE

You are our first outbound setter. Your single job: book 15-minute Zoom demos onto the founder's calendar. You will work from 500+ pre-researched Canadian clinic leads. Long-term role with a clear path to senior position within 12 months.



DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES

- 40–60 outbound calls per day from our lead list

- Get past gatekeepers; book Zoom demos with clinic managers

- Send pre-written follow-up
s within 30 minutes of each call

- Log every call outcome

- Run our 14-day follow-up sequence (calls +
s)

- 20-minute daily Slack/Zoom huddle



PAY

- $7 USD/hour, full-time (40 hrs/week), weekly via PayPal

- $50 USD per Zoom demo booked AND attended

- $250 USD per signed clinic (paid 30 days after install)

- Productive setters earn $2,500–3,000 USD/month consistently.



HOURS

- Mon–Fri, 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM Eastern Time = 8:00 PM – 4:00 AM Manila time.

- This is a graveyard shift. If you cannot commit to the hours long-term, do not apply.



WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO

- No data entry, admin, social media, or general VA tasks

- No working for other employers on the side — dedicated, exclusive role

- No cold pitching patients — B2B only (clinic managers and owners)



REQUIRED

- Minimum 3 years outbound B2B cold calling — real cold dialing to businesses, not appointment-setting or lead-gen forms

- Strong, neutral, easily-understood English (clinic managers will be skeptical; thick accents will not work)

- Experience with North American businesses

- Quiet workspace, reliable internet, clear-mic headset

- Comfort with rejection — 30 "no"s a day is normal

- Self-discipline without supervision



PREFERRED

- SaaS or tech sales background

- Healthcare/medical office experience

- HubSpot, Google Calendar, Slack

- Sales background (not customer service)



HOW TO APPLY

Applications missing any of the below will be rejected without review:

1. 150-word intro — why you're right for this role

2. 90-second voice recording reading this script aloud:

"Hi, this is [your name] calling from Dr. Kaczmarek's office in Windsor, Ontario. I'm reaching out because Dr. Kaczmarek is a family physician who built a system that's helping busy clinics make about thirty-five thousand dollars more per doctor per year by better coordinating their staff and rooms. He's currently adding a few clinics in the area at a early partner rate. Would the clinic manager be available for a quick 30-second conversation?" 

3. Outbound B2B experience. For each role:

- Company name

- Your title and dates (month/year)

- What product or service you were calling about

 -Average calls per day and what you were measured on (meetings booked, deals closed, etc.)

4. Confirm hours availability (Mon–Fri, 8AM–4PM ET)

5. One sentence: What's the difference between a "no" and a "not yet" in sales?



TIMELINE

- Applications close in 10 days

- Top 5 candidates get a 30-minute Zoom interview with the founder

- Hire starts within 1 week of interview

- Two-week paid trial at full base + bonuses



We're not in a rush. We'll wait for the right hire.

Working fully in DaVinci Resolve

Editing primarily one-take walkthrough clips

Applying subtle speed adjustments and ramping

Stabilizing footage where appropriate

Straightening verticals and correcting any distracting tilt

Applying provided color nodes/plugins

Making interiors feel bright, clean, and natural

Exporting final videos in the requested format



Ideal fit:



Someone who has experience with real estate, interior, architecture, or lifestyle video edits and understands how to make a walkthrough feel elegant and professional without over-editing it.



This would be per project / per job, with ongoing work available for the right editor.

, phone, and portal.

On-time completion rate for recurring HOA tasks and compliance filings

Owner/resident satisfaction score; complaint resolution time

Type of Work: Full Time

Starting Rate: $3.00/hour

Hours: 40 hours per week

Schedule: 5 working days per week within a Monday through Saturday operating window. Sundays are always off.

Time Zone: Meaningful overlap with Chicago business hours required.



I run a fast-moving property management business in Chicago. I need a full-time right-hand operator to help with tenant follow-up, vendor coordination, scheduling, documentation, admin work, and executive support.



This is not a passive “wait for instructions” VA role.



Your job is simple:



Protect my time. Keep the business moving. Close loops.



We manage rental properties in Chicago, including tenant issues, maintenance, rent collection, vendor coordination, paperwork, scheduling, and day-to-day operational fires.



This role is for someone who wants to become the CEO’s operational backbone, not someone looking for easy admin work.



------------------Compensation Notice------------------



This role starts at $3.00/hour.



The starting rate is fixed and not negotiable during the interview process.



Do not apply with the idea that you will interview, impress me, and then ask for a higher starting rate.



However, good people should not feel stuck. Strong performers can earn more responsibility and better compensation over time.



Performance reviews may happen after 30 days and 90 days based on reliability, communication, ownership, judgment, attendance, throughput, and ability to close loops.



If $3.00/hour is not acceptable as the starting rate, do not apply.



If you are only looking for temporary work while searching for something better, do not apply.



------------------What You Will Do------------------



You will help with:

• Tenant follow-up and rent/payment coordination

• Calling or messaging tenants, vendors, and contractors

• Scheduling maintenance and following up until work is done

• Tracking open issues until they are fully closed

• Updating spreadsheets, Trello cards, Google Drive files, and internal systems

• Managing invoices, reminders, admin records, and documentation

• Reviewing training videos and SOPs independently

• Preparing summaries, updates, and next-step recommendations

• Helping with scheduling, logistics, calendar coordination, and executive-support tasks



This is not a narrow job-description role where you say, “That’s not my task.”



If it is legal, professional, ethical, and helps buy back the CEO’s time, you should be willing to help handle it.



------------------Who This Role Is For------------------



This role is for you if:

• You are assertive, not timid

• You are comfortable making outbound calls

• You can speak directly to tenants, vendors, and contractors

• You do not freeze when someone is upset

• You can self-train using videos, SOPs, screenshots, and written instructions

• You ask good questions

• You communicate clearly when something is unclear

• You can handle direct feedback

• You want to become a high-trust, long-term operator



------------------Who Should Not Apply------------------



Do not apply if:

• You are shy on the phone

• You avoid confrontation

• You need step-by-step instructions for every task

• You only want easy admin work

• You disappear when confused

• You say “done” when a task is only partially done

• You dislike direct feedback

• You cannot work consistently during agreed hours

• You already have too many other clients or jobs

• You plan to ask for more than $3.00/hour before proving yourself



If you d
 the role is not for you, I expect professional communication and a clean handoff. Disappearing without notice is not acceptable.



------------------AI Tools and Throughput------------------



AI tools, including ChatGPT, are allowed.



I care about throughput, judgment, and completed work.



AI should help you move faster, organize better, summarize clearly, document work, and produce cleaner output.



AI should not be used to avoid thinking, avoid phone calls, avoid decisions, avoid accountability, or send generic answers.



If AI makes your work faster and more accurate, good.



If AI makes you passive, vague, dependent, or generic, this role is not for you.



------------------Required Skills------------------



You must be strong in:

• Spoken English

• Written English

• Phone communication

• Tenant/customer service

• Direct follow-up

• Google Sheets or Excel

• Gmail

• Google Drive

• Trello or similar task-management tools

• Calendar/scheduling

• Documentation

• Self-learning

• Prioritization

• Problem-solving



Property management, collections, dispatch, call center, executive assistant, legal admin, or operations experience is a major plus.



------------------Work Schedule------------------



This is a full-time role.



Expected schedule:

• 40 hours per week

• 5 working days per week

• Workdays may fall between Monday and Saturday

• Sundays are always off

• Must have meaningful overlap with Chicago business hours



------------------Application Instructions------------------



To apply, use this subject line:



RIGHT HAND OPERATOR - $3 FIXED RATE



Do not send a generic cover letter. Generic applications will be ignored.



Answer every question below.
. Rate Confirmation------------------



This role starts at $3.00/hour.



Do you understand and accept that this is the fixed starting rate?



Answer clearly:



Yes, I accept the $3.00/hour fixed starting rate.
. Direct Communication Test------------------



A tenant is late on rent and says:



“I’m not paying the late fee. I had a hard month, and it’s unfair. Remove it.”



Write exactly what you would say back to the tenant.



Keep it short. Do not be rude. Do not be weak.
. Judgment Test------------------



It is Monday morning. Three things happen at the same time:



A tenant says there is no heat.

A contractor missed a scheduled repair.

A tenant is late on rent and avoiding payment.



What do you handle first, second, and third?



Explain why.
. CEO Time-Buyback Test------------------



I tell you:



“I am traveling tomorrow. I have a meeting, a workout plan, a meal schedule, a car issue, and several business tasks open. I need you to make tomorrow easier for me.”



What steps would you take to help?



Be specific.
. Phone Confidence------------------



Are you comfortable making outbound calls to tenants, contractors, vendors, and leads?



Answer clearly: Yes or No.



Then explain your experience.
. AI Judgment Test------------------



How do you use AI or ChatGPT to get more work done?



Give one example.



Also explain one situation where you should not rely on AI and should use your own judgment instead.
. Availability------------------



What hours can you work in Chicago time?



Are you available full-time?



Do you currently have other jobs or clients?



If yes, explain your current workload.
. Long-Term Fit------------------



Are you looking for a long-term role or a temporary role?



If you were offered a higher-paying opportunity after a few weeks or months, how would you handle that professionally?
. Voice Sample------------------



Record a short 60 to 90 second voice note answering this:



“Why would you be a strong right-hand operator for a direct, fast-moving CEO?”



Include the link in your application.



Applications without a voice sample may be ignored.



------------------Final Note------------------



I am not looking for someone who only interviews well.



I am looking for someone who can work, communicate, follow up, learn quickly, and become useful fast.



If you are reliable, assertive, direct, organized, and serious about growing into a long-term operator role, apply.



If you want an easy role, vague expectations, flexible excuses, or a higher starting rate, do not apply.

s

title: REAL ESTATE MARKET & LAND ACQUISITION ANALYST
description:
About Us

MGVG Development is a Georgia-based multifamily development company focused on developing workforce housing communities throughout the state. We currently own and operate approximately 400 apartment units and are actively expanding our development pipeline.



We are seeking a highly analytical, detail-oriented Real Estate Market & Land Acquisition Analyst to identify underserved housing markets, locate development opportunities, and help drive our expansion strategy.



This is not a typical virtual assistant position. We are looking for someone who can think critically, conduct independent research, and help identify our next development opportunities.

Position Overview

Your primary responsibility is to identify Georgia markets that have a demonstrated need for additional housing and then locate development sites that meet our acquisition criteria.



You will effectively serve as our acquisitions research department by identifying both the market opportunity and the land opportunity.

Primary Responsibilities

Market Research & Housing Demand Analysis

• Identify underserved housing markets throughout Georgia

• Analyze population growth, employment growth, housing shortages, vacancy rates, occupancy levels, rent trends, and workforce housing demand

• Review comprehensive plans, housing studies, and economic development announcements

• Identify cities and counties actively seeking additional housing development



Development Pipeline Research

• Track multifamily developments under construction

• Monitor planning commission agendas, rezoning applications, and development permits

• Identify competing apartment developments and estimate future supply



Land Acquisition Research

• Identify development sites through Crexi, LoopNet, LandWatch, 
, Zillow, county GIS systems, and local broker listings

• Verify ownership, zoning, rezoning potential, utility availability, flood status, and road frontage



Market & Site Feasibility

• Determine whether rents can support $1,150+ one-bedroom units and $1,300+ two-bedroom units

• Verify documented housing need and likelihood of multifamily support

• Evaluate market competition and site viability

Development Site Criteria

• Georgia locations only

• Population greater than 13,000

• 4-8 acre parcels

• Highway frontage or major road frontage

• Water and sewer available

• Outside flood zones

• Suitable for 72-120 unit apartment developments

• Land pricing generally between $25,000-$50,000 per acre

• Strong workforce housing demand

• Potential for rezoning to multifamily

Weekly Deliverables

Market Opportunity Report:

• Top markets ranked by housing need, rent potential, employment growth, development competition, political support, and overall opportunity score



Land Opportunity Report:

• Address

• Parcel number

• Acres

• Asking price

• Zoning

• Utility availability

• Flood zone status

• Rent comps

• Development activity nearby

• Overall acquisition score



Acquisition Recommendations:

• Top opportunities with supporting rationale

Required Skills

• Strong real estate research experience

• Excellent internet research skills

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills

• Strong written English

• Ability to work independently

• High attention to detail

• Strong critical thinking skills

Preferred Experience

• Multifamily development

• Commercial real estate

• Land acquisition

• GIS mapping

• Planning and zoning

• Market feasibility analysis

• Economic development research

Compensation

Please include:

• Hourly rate

• Weekly availability

• Relevant experience

• Resume

• Examples of similar work completed

Application Test

Qualified candidates will complete a paid test assignment:



1. Identify a Georgia market with documented housing demand.

2. Identify one development site meeting our criteria.

3. Provide supporting research and recommendations.



Applicants who can demonstrate strong research, analytical ability, and independent thinking will be given priority.

title: Operations & Fulfilment Coordinator
description:
GCB is a Queensland-based windows and doors business going through an exciting transformation. After six years as a family business, we're building out a fully professional team with new systems and clear processes. This is a ground-floor opportunity to own a critical role as we scale.



About the Role



Once the sales team closes a deal, it lands with you. You are the engine that makes sure every order is fulfilled accurately, every customer is kept in the loop, and every delivery happens on time — and only after payment is received.



Your core responsibilities:



• Generate invoices and confirm deposits are received before any order is placed

• Triple-check every order (colour, size, specifications) with the customer before sending to the manufacturer — you are the last line of defence against costly errors

• Prepare and send orders to the manufacturer with complete accuracy

• Proactively update customers on order status — they should never need to call wondering what's happening

• Handle customer calls and complaints professionally, set clear expectations, and follow through on every resolution

• Ensure completion payments are received before any delivery is dispatched

• Coordinate with the warehouse manager on incoming deliveries and delivery scheduling

• Log and maintain all activity in Zoho CRM — accurate records are non-negotiable

• Support the sales team during high-volume periods to help prepare quotes (secondary responsibility)



Systems you'll use:



• Zoho CRM — daily hub for order tracking and customer communications

• Zoho Quoting — for reviewing and supporting quote preparation

• Xero — for invoicing and tracking payments



What We're Looking For



• Proven background in operations, order management, or customer service coordination

• Exceptional attention to detail — this is the #1 requirement

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

• Comfortable managing unhappy customers and resolving issues calmly

• Proactive mindset — you spot problems before the customer does

• Reliable, organised, and self-managing

• Available 8am–4pm AEST, Monday–Friday + occasional Saturdays



Role Details:



• Full-time, 8 hours/day

• Fully remote

• Queensland business hours: 8am–4pm AEST



THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU if you:



• Have a system for everything and never let things fall through the cracks

• Take pride in being proactive — customers never need to chase you because you've already reached out

• Stay calm and professional when a customer is unhappy and turn complaints into positive outcomes

• Have high attention to detail — you triple-check things before sending because you know the cost of getting it wrong

• Thrive in a growing, fast-moving business where you can genuinely shape how things are done



DO NOT APPLY if you:



• Need to be constantly told what to do or chased for updates

• Get flustered when customers are upset or frustrated

• Are sloppy with details — wrong measurements, wrong colours, wrong specs cost real money

• Have never used a CRM or don't know what Xero is

• Are looking for a relaxed, low-accountability role

• Can't commit to 8am–4pm Queensland time (AEST), Monday–Friday (and occasional Saturdays)



How to Apply — MUST complete all three:



Tell us about a time you caught an error before it became a problem — what happened and what did you do?



Describe how you manage multiple tasks or active orders at once — what system do you use?



Complete this DISC personality assessment (~10 mins) and send a screenshot of your pie chart:

???? https://www.123test.com/disc-personality-test/



Applications missing any of the above will not be reviewed.

title: Architect
description:
THIS IS A REPOST OF A RECENT JOB OPENING THAT IS NOT FILLED.  I had a couple of talented architects but we found we had some knowledge based gaps.  I found I need someone with a bit deeper skillset and who understands topography and US building standards better.  



Since this is a remote position some of these requirements will be tweaked.  You would be communicating with our team and clients remotely via
, WhatsApp, and possibly via video on FaceTime or Zoom.  I may tweak this description as I see what responses I get.  Thank you for taking the time to apply and for giving me all the info I need to make a great decision.



Job Description

Who We Are

We are a small design-build custom home and renovation firm based in NC, serving the mountains of Western North Carolina. We handle everything in-house, from initial design through final construction, which means our designer isn't handing drawings off to someone else and walking away. You're part of the build from first sketch to finished product.

We're a small, high-performing team that takes on fewer projects intentionally so we can do each one right. I have found that I need to include a bit of detail in the job post to see if you actually read it all.  I find that at least 50% don't read it all.  If you skip over all of these it means you are just blasting out responses and have no attention to detail and I will delete your application. Our clients are homeowners and investors who expect precision, professionalism, and a design partner who listens. We've built our reputation on doing exactly that.



The Role

We're looking for an Architectural Designer who brings real expertise and takes ownership of the design function. You'll work directly with clients from early concept through construction documentation, collaborating daily with our project managers and pre-construction team. You'll be in the “room” virtually” if needed for the conversations that matter.

We want someone who brings strong judgment, exercises initiative, and raises the quality of our work.



What You'll Do

Lead design development across all phases, from initial programming and schematic concepts through design development and construction documentation

Understand client design meetings and selections appointments, work with our interior designer and clients through material, finish, and specification decisions across multiple rounds

Produce construction drawings and documentation that our project managers can build from without ambiguity

Create renderings and visual presentations that communicate design intent clearly to clients

In your response, tell me the difference between European & US style windows.

Collaborate with pre-construction on design-driven cost estimates and value engineering decisions

Maintain design intent through the build by staying engaged with the field team during construction

In your response, tell me what hourly rate you need and your minimum and maximum hours you would work.

Contribute to improving our internal design process as the company grows



What We're Looking For

5+ years of experience in residential design, preferably custom homes or high-end renovation

Required proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, and SketchUp or other similar software

In your response tell me how big a 2x4 and a 2x10 is.

Experience producing high-quality renderings for client presentations

Working knowledge of US residential building codes and construction methods; familiarity with North Carolina codes is a plus

A portfolio that demonstrates design sensibility, complete construction documents, and client-ready renderings

In your response, tell me the clearances required for bathroom fixtures.

Clear communicator who handles client relationships with confidence and works well without heavy oversight

In your response, tell me why you are the right fit for this role.

Familiarity with design-build delivery is a plus; genuine interest in how buildings get built is non-negotiable

Bonus if you bring experience with: Rhino 3D, Grasshopper, ArchiCAD, Chief Architect, Adobe Creative Suite, or Bluebeam



Salary

Please provide your required hourly rate.



Why This Role

You'll have direct influence over a company's design direction, not executing someone else's vision as one of many. You'll work with a team that respects craft, holds high standards, and takes pride in the finished product. 



To Apply

Send a sample of your work that would be ready to permit in the US market.  Apply directly through Onlinejobs.ph. Include your portfolio with your application, demonstrating your design work, construction documents, and renderings. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

title: eCommerce Virtual Assistant
description:
We are expanding our remote team and looking for a reliable, disciplined, and ambitious eCommerce Virtual Assistant who wants long-term growth.



Our local agency is based in the Philippines and manages multiple eCommerce brands for international clients. This role is for someone who takes work seriously, learns fast, and wants to build a real career in digital work, not just a short-term VA job.



This is a busy and fast-paced role. Since we work with multiple clients, there will be days with several tasks, urgent revisions, and deadlines. We need someone who can stay organized, work under pressure, follow instructions properly, and remain reliable even when the workload gets heavy.



If you are organized, proactive, and can work independently, this is a strong opportunity.



About the Role



Start Date

Immediate



Schedule

Graveyard shift Philippine time

Monday to Friday

Weekends off



Please note that occasional overtime may be required when there are urgent client tasks, important deadlines, or time-sensitive updates. This does not happen every day, but we need someone who understands that eCommerce work can sometimes require flexibility.



Responsibilities



You will support daily operations across multiple eCommerce brands. Tasks include:



• Managing and updating Shopify, WooCommerce, and Amazon stores

• Writing, editing, and optimizing product listings

• Conducting product, competitor, and market research

• Handling basic customer service and order processing

• Completing website updates and admin tasks

• Helping with basic website layout and design improvements

• Using ChatGPT and AI tools to improve speed and accuracy

• Following systems, checklists, and instructions precisely

• Responding quickly to task updates during working hours

• Staying organized even when the workload is busy



As you improve, you will manage client accounts more independently and take on higher-value tasks.



Requirements



• Fast learner with strong problem-solving skills

• Organized, detail-oriented, and accountable

• Able to follow instructions and meet deadlines

• Strong communication and reliability

• Proactive mindset and good work ethic

• Comfortable working in a busy and fast-paced environment

• Able to handle pressure and urgent tasks professionally

• Own laptop or desktop

• Stable, high-speed internet connection

• Fully available during assigned working hours

• No other job, client, or commitment that will affect your focus, schedule, or performance



Preferred but Not Required



• Experience with Shopify

• Basic graphic design skills or Canva experience

• Understanding of layout, spacing, and clean design

• Familiarity with ChatGPT or other AI tools

• Basic video editing skills using CapCut

• Previous VA, eCommerce, customer service, or admin experience



We prioritize attitude, discipline, consistency, and reliability over years of experience. Skills can be trained, but work ethic, honesty, and commitment are required from the start.



Compensation and Growth



• Monthly Range: ?25,000 to ?30,000

• Performance Bonus: ?5,000 to ?8,000 per month

• Clear path for raises, promotions, and leadership roles

• Long-term stability for consistent top performers



Why Join Us



• Stable long-term work with a structured eCommerce agency

• Clear systems, feedback, and guidance

• Learn Shopify, Amazon, WooCommerce, and TikTok Shop operations

• Work with automation and AI tools daily

• Gain real experience handling international eCommerce brands

• Real opportunity to grow into senior or leadership roles



Important



This is not a passive VA role where you only wait for instructions. We need someone who can move fast, think clearly, stay focused, and take responsibility for their work.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the company long term. If you are only looking for a side job, temporary work, or something easy, this may not be the right fit.



Application Instructions



Please submit the following:



Resume

Internet speed test result

Laptop or PC specifications, including model, processor, RAM, and storage

Short cover letter explaining who you are, what you’ve done, and why you are a strong fit



NOTE:

This is a long-term position with strong potential for career growth. We are looking for someone fully committed to the role. You must not have other jobs, clients, or commitments that may interfere with your schedule, focus, availability, or performance.

title: Operations Manager for eCommerce Agency
description:
We are a growing eCommerce agency working with multiple international clients, and we are looking for a sharp, highly organized, and high-energy Operations Manager who can also handle project management at a strong level.



This is a very important role inside the business.



You will be the person responsible for helping keep the agency organized, making sure tasks are clearly delegated, deadlines are met, communication is strong, and team output is high quality. This is not a passive role and not a basic admin role. We need someone who can think fast, move fast, lead properly, and keep the team aligned.



This role is best for someone who has real experience in operations, team management, project management, eCommerce, and client communication.



What You’ll Be Responsible For

Operations and Team Management



-Manage the day-to-day operations of the agency

-Oversee remote tea
mbers and make sure everyone is aligned and productive

-Delegate tasks clearly and properly based on priority and skill level

-Follow up with tea
mbers to make sure tasks are moving and deadlines are being met

-Spot bottlenecks, delays, and weak performance early and address them fast

-Help improve accountability, structure, and overall team discipline



Project Management



-Take client requests, meeting notes, Loom videos, and feedback and turn them into clear, actionable tasks

-Assign tasks inside ClickUp or other project management tools with proper context, deadlines, and priorities

-Make sure tasks are not just posted, but actually understood by the team

-Keep projects moving forward without needing constant follow-up from the owner

-Ensure urgent tasks are handled on time and important items do not get delayed



Quality Control and Delivery



-Review work before it goes back to the client

-Make sure deliverables are accurate, polished, and aligned with what the client asked for

-Catch mistakes, weak output, or missing details before submission

-Maintain strong internal quality control across all active client projects



Client Communication



-Help manage client communication in a professional, clear, and confident way

-Send updates, follow-ups, and replies on time

-Make sure clients feel taken care of, updated, and supported

-Understand the client’s priorities and communicate them clearly to the team



Systems and Process Improvement



-Improve internal workflows and agency systems

-Help build better SOPs, structure, and processes

-Suggest ways to make the business more efficient

-Identify areas where automation or better systems can save time and improve delivery



What We’re Looking For



-Proven experience as an Operations Manager, Project Manager, or similar leadership role

-Strong experience in eCommerce, websites, and digital marketing environments

-Excellent written and verbal English communication

-Strong leadership and delegation skills

-Very organized, detail-oriented, and proactive

-Able to work with urgency and manage multiple moving parts

-Strong problem-solving ability

-Comfortable managing remote teams

-Comfortable using tools like ClickUp, Slack, Google Workspace, Loom, and similar platforms

-Able to take ownership and reduce the owner’s workload, not add to it



Big Plus If You Have Experience With



-Shopify

-WordPress

-Klaviyo

-Customer support workflows

-Order processing

-Inventory updates

-Canva or basic design coordination

-CRM and automation tools

-Agency operations

-Managing multiple client accounts at once



Important for This Role



This is a full-time, high-focus role inside a small but growing agency.



Because this position is crucial to daily operations, we are looking for someone who can give this role their full attention and energy. You must not have other jobs or active side commitments that will affect your focus, availability, or performance here.



We need someone fully committed, dependable, responsive, and ready to take real ownership.



Who This Role Is For



This role is for someone who:



-likes structure

-can lead people properly

-knows how to manage pressure

-can keep projects organized

-communicates clearly

-has strong urgency

-takes pride in keeping the business running smoothly



This is not for someone who only wants to post tasks, wait for instructions, or do the bare minimum.



Position Details



-Full-time

-Long-term

-Remote

-High ownership role

-Growth opportunity for the right person



How to Apply



To show that you actually read this job post, include the word juice in your cover letter.



Please send:



-Your resume

-A short cover letter explaining your relevant experience

-Why you are a strong fit for this role

-The tools and platforms you have worked with

-Your previous experience managing teams, projects, or agency operations

-If you have strong operations and project management experience in an eCommerce or digital agency setting, we’d love to hear from you.

title: GoHighLevel (GHL) Platform Specialist — Build & Architecture
description:
GoHighLevel (GHL) Platform Specialist — Build & Architecture

Type: Part-time, Remote VA — 15-25 hours per week Location: Philippines-based (remote). You'll work directly with our U.S.-based in-house team, so reliable overlap with U.S. Central business hours is required. Reports to: VP and Marketing Lead

________________________________________

description:
Job Title: SEO & AI Search Specialist (Boutique Finance/Mortgage)

Job Type: Part-Time (8–10 hours per week to start)



About Us

Orca Home Loans is a boutique mortgage broking firm based in Sydney, Australia. We prioritize a "strategy-first" approach to lending, focusing on clear, jargon-free guidance to help our clients make informed, long-term financial decisions. We specialize in providing tailored solutions for first-home buyer loans, refinancing, and investment property purchases.



The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled, part-time SEO Specialist to elevate the technical SEO maturity of our website (
). Your objective is to build enduring organic visibility across traditional search engines while simultaneously optimizing our content for the rapidly evolving landscape of Generative AI search engines (often referred to as Generative Engine Optimization or GEO).



You will work collaboratively with our team in an agile, iterative sprint model where we agree on tasks, you execute, and we review together.



Key Responsibilities

Traditional & Technical SEO: Implement robust strategies to ensure our website ranks highly for high-intent mortgage queries in the competitive Sydney market.



AI Searchability (GEO): Structure online content so it is surfaced, cited, and recommended by AI-driven search engines and conversational LLMs.



Structured Data Implementation: Implement and audit comprehensive schema markup (such as FAQs, Organization, and Service schemas) to give AI clear context, as LLMs rely heavily on structured data to accurately interpret content.



Content Formatting for Extraction: Format our educational articles and guides using clear heading hierarchies, bulleted lists, and direct answers, which are highly preferred by AI models for extraction and citation.



Crawler Management: Audit our robots.txt files and server configurations to ensure that both traditional and AI crawlers can successfully access and read our content without being inadvertently blocked.



Recency & Maintenance: Implement a schedule to regularly review and update existing content, leveraging the strong recency bias that AI systems use to select current, trustworthy sources.



About You

Demonstrated, verifiable experience improving searchability, organic traffic, and lead generation for service-based or finance businesses.



Deep understanding of modern SEO best practices and emerging GEO techniques required to capture AI search visibility.



Technical proficiency with Google Search Console, Google Analytics (GA4), schema markup deployment, and website architecture.



Reliable, proactive, honest, and comfortable working within a strictly scoped, part-time hour cap.



How to Apply (Please Read Carefully)

Attention to detail is paramount for this role. To ensure you have read this description in its entirety, please follow these exact application steps:



Use the subject line: "SEO Application: AUTHORITY" (Applications without this exact subject line will be automatically filtered out).



Include a link to your updated resume or onlinejobs.ph profile.



Provide a brief summary or a link to a specific project case study where you successfully improved the organic search visibility of a business.



Confirm your availability for 8–10 hours per week and state your expected hourly rate in USD.

mbers.

title: Private Online Psychiatric Mental Health Tutor, Nurse practitioner, Doctor (Nonprofit initiative)
description:
Private Online Psychiatric Mental Health Tutor (Doctor or equivalent) 



Nonprofit Educational Initiative



About This Opportunity



This opportunity is part of a nonprofit educational mission focused on supporting learning and development in the field of mental health. The goal is to help equip individuals with strong foundational knowledge in psychiatric mental health, especially for future service, education, and mission driven work.



By participating, you will be contributing to a meaningful initiative that aims to expand understanding and access to mental health education.



Role Overview



We are looking for a licensed doctor, preferably a psychiatrist, or another highly qualified licensed mental health professional based in the Philippines to provide private one on one online tutoring in psychiatric mental health.



This is a paid education project. It is not a clinical role, not for patient care, not for independent practice, and not a substitute for formal school, certification, or licensure.



The purpose of this role is to deliver structured, high quality education in the core areas of psychiatric mental health knowledge.



About the Student



The student has a healthcare background, strong CDI and clinical documentation experience, and a strong ability to learn quickly. She already understands medical documentation and clinical workflows, but now wants to build deeper knowledge in psychiatric mental health.



She works full time, so the program must be:



• practical  

• organized  

• efficient  

• flexible  



What We Are Looking For



We are not looking for casual tutoring. We are looking for someone who can:



• mentor and guide the student in a structured way  

• design a clear learning pathway from start to finish  

• build a condensed, goal oriented program  

• help bridge clinical documentation knowledge into psychiatric thinking  



Your role is to equip and develop the student’s understanding in a serious and structured way, similar to a mentor or preceptor style relationship, but strictly for education only.



You should be able to take someone with a strong documentation background and help her understand how mental health professionals:



• assess patients  

• think through symptoms  

• form diagnoses  

• choose treatment approaches  

• understand medication logic  

• document psychiatric encounters  

• plan ongoing care  



Program Expectations



The program should be structured and intentional, not random sessions.



We are especially interested in applicants who can propose a clear and realistic learning plan explaining:



• how you would take the student from point A to point Z  

• how you would structure the learning, such as weekly sessions, modules, exercises, or guided case discussions  

• how you would pace the program for someone working full time  

• what outcomes the student should achieve by the end  



We expect approximately one session per week, although you may recommend the structure you believe is best.



Ideally, we hope the program can be taught in a boot camp style format, with the goal of bringing the student to a strong crash course level of psychiatric mental health knowledge in about 12 weeks or less, if realistic. We are open to your professional judgment on how best to structure this.



Core Topics to Cover



The program should build strong knowledge in areas such as:



• psychiatric assessment  

• psychiatric interviewing  

• mental status examination  

• DSM based diagnosis  

• differential diagnosis  

• psychopharmacology  

• medication selection and reasoning for learning purposes only  

• treatment planning  

• care planning  

• psychiatric documentation, including SOAP style notes  

• case based discussion  

• clinical reasoning  

• safety and risk assessment  

• crisis awareness and escalation thinking  

• basic psychotherapy concepts  

• patient education  

• follow up thinking and longitudinal care planning  



We are also especially interested in candidates who can teach the core foundation often associated with advanced psychiatric training, including the 3 Ps:



• advanced pathophysiology  

• advanced pharmacology  

• advanced health assessment  



The overall goal is to help the student build the type of psychiatric mental health knowledge commonly developed in PMHNP style training, while fully understanding that this tutoring program is for education only.



End Goal



By the end of the program, the student should have a strong educational foundation in how psychiatric mental health professionals think and approach:



• assessment  

• diagnosis  

• treatment options  

• medication reasoning  

• documentation  

• care planning  



This is about developing clinical thinking and understanding, not simply memorizing information.



Important Clarification



This program is strictly for education and knowledge building only.



It does not replace formal PMHNP education, certification, or licensure. The student is not seeking to practice based on this program alone.



Who This Is Best For



We are looking for:



• licensed doctor preferred  

• psychiatrist strongly preferred  

• other licensed mental health professionals with strong psychiatric experience may be considered  



Ideal candidates will be:



• experienced in psychiatric or mental health care  

• able to teach clearly in English  

• comfortable with one on one online teaching  

• organized, reliable, and professional  

• experienced in teaching, mentoring, tutoring, precepting, or curriculum building  

• able to design a structured learning program  



A practicing doctor in the Philippines who wants flexible remote teaching work may be a strong fit.



Program Setup



• fully remote and online  

• private one on one format  

• flexible schedule  

• approximately one session per week, or as proposed  

• short term, structured program preferred  

• Zoom based sessions are acceptable  



Budget



• total budget: PHP 35,000 for the full program  



Application Requirements



To apply, please send to:







• your CV or resume  

• your professional background  

• your license and credentials  

• your psychiatric or mental health experience  

• any teaching, tutoring, mentoring, or precepting experience  

• a short introduction video of 3 minutes or less introducing yourself, your experience, and your teaching style  

• a brief proposal explaining:  

?• how you would structure the program  

?• how you would take the student from a clinical documentation background to strong psychiatric mental health knowledge  

?• what your teaching approach would be  

?• what outcomes you expect by the end  

• your availability for an interview  



Final Note



This is a unique opportunity to combine professional expertise with meaningful educational impact. As part of this nonprofit initiative, your contribution helps support mental health education and future service in this field.



We are looking for someone who takes teaching seriously and is willing to guide the student with clarity, structure, and purpose.

title: Academic Remote Research & Writing Training Program (Paid)
description:
Academic Support and Learning Program



Our church nonprofit is building a long term training and selection program for individuals who may later support our nonprofit initiatives.



This is a paid remote training program for applicants who enjoy studying, learning, writing, research, tutoring, and academic support work.



We are looking for college graduates, college degree holders, straight A students, or academically strong college level students who are studious, reliable, eager to learn, and serious about producing quality work.



This opportunity is best for someone who loves to study, enjoys learning, communicates well, writes clearly, and has the potential to become a strong tutor or academic support person for nonprofit related programs.



Character and Reliability Required



Before anything else, character and reliability come first.



We carefully evaluate character during the first sessions. Many people may be intelligent or academically capable, but if we do not see reliability, respect, honesty, quality work, and strong work ethic early on, we will not be able to continue with that applicant.



We are looking for people who:



• Follow through on commitments

• Communicate respectfully

• Provide consistent progress updates

• Complete assignments they start

• Take responsibility seriously

• Stay responsive and professional

• Show honesty, discipline, and good character

• Take pride in producing clean and quality work

• Have strong study habits and academic discipline



If an applicant stops responding, disappears, abandons work midway, submits careless work, or fails to communicate, the program will end for that applicant.



Our nonprofit depends on people who finish the work they start and care about the quality of what they submit.



About the Training Program



Participants will complete structured study modules and produce academic work.



The program includes:



• Research based essays

• PowerPoint presentations with speaker notes

• Organized written work based on assigned topics

• Proper citations and references

• Final capstone project



The program evaluates:



• Writing ability

• Research and analysis

• Communication

• Discipline and consistency

• Professionalism

• Integrity

• Ability to learn and follow instructions

• Quality of submitted work

• Attention to detail



This program is designed for applicants who enjoy studying and learning and want to strengthen their academic and professional skills.



Pay and Program Structure



• Pay ranges from PHP 4,500 to PHP 7,000 per completed program

• Final compensation may depend on the agreement, applicant qualifications, program track, work quality, and completion requirements

• Program includes 15 structured modules

• Program length is an 8 week session

• Program is self paced and competency based

• Strong applicants often finish in about 7 weeks

• Payment is based on successful completion of the required program work

• Applicants must complete the full program requirements

• Poor quality, incomplete, careless, copied, or non original work will not be accepted



Each module requires:



• APA style essay

• PowerPoint presentation with speaker notes

• Proper citations and references

• Organized academic writing

• Original work

• Quality writing and clear presentation



Module 15 is the final capstone project.



Available Program Tracks



Applicants must choose one program track.



• Program A: Criminal Justice and Community Safety. Topics include justice systems, criminology, crime prevention, and community safety.

• Program B: Healthcare Administration and Community Health. Topics include healthcare systems, health policy, healthcare management, and community health programs.

• Program C: Nursing, Health Promotion, and Community Care. Topics include community health nursing, prevention strategies, patient education, and health promotion.

• Program D: United States Studies. Topics include United States history, society, culture, and civic institutions.

• Program E: Business and Administration. Topics include business writing, management, leadership, organizational behavior, marketing, business ethics, operations, and administration.

• Program F: Recreation, Tourism, and Hospitality. Topics include recreation management, tourism studies, hospitality service, event planning, customer experience, community recreation, and travel development.



Academic Writing and Original Work Requirement



Academic writing in APA style is mandatory.



Applicants are expected to already be strong in writing, research, organization, citations, academic formatting, and quality academic work.



All work must be original and written by the applicant.



AI generated writing is not allowed.



AI tools may only be used for limited support, such as brainstorming, outlining, grammar review, and study support.



However:



• Copying is not allowed

• Plagiarism is not allowed

• AI generated submissions are not allowed

• Careless rewriting or copied content is not allowed

• Sources must be cited properly in APA style

• Originality checks may be used

• Work must be Turnitin safe through originality, proper citation, and honest academic writing

• Applicants must submit only their own original work



We are looking for applicants who are genuinely good at academic work and can write, research, cite, organize, and present properly without depending on AI to do the work for them.



Who Should Apply



You should have:



• A college degree

• A strong academic background

• Strong reading and writing ability

• Good grades or a strong record of academic performance

• Straight A level study habits preferred

• Interest in tutoring, studying, research, or academic support

• Ability to produce quality written and presentation work



You must also be:



• Studious and intellectually curious

• A quick learner

• Strong in writing and organized thinking

• Comfortable communicating through WhatsApp

• Able to provide daily progress updates

• Dependable and responsive

• Respectful and professional

• Serious about completing what you start

• Careful with details and quality



This opportunity works best for people who take commitments seriously, enjoy learning, and care about doing the work properly.



What This Can Lead To



Applicants who demonstrate strong work ethic, honesty, consistent performance, and quality work may be invited into ongoing paid work supporting our nonprofit programs.



We continue working only with people who show:



• Reliability

• Consistent communication

• Dependable work quality

• Professionalism

• Trustworthiness

• Respectful attitude

• Strong academic effort

• Careful and quality submissions



How to Apply



Send your application through WhatsApp:




Please include:



• Updated resume

• Full name and timezone

• Daily availability in hours per day

• Program choice A, B, C, D, E, or F

• Writing sample, 1 to 2 pages in APA style

• PowerPoint sample, 5 to 10 slides with speaker notes

• Confirmation statement below



Confirmation Statement



“I understand originality checks may be used. AI generated writing is not allowed. AI may only be used for limited assistance. I will submit only original work and include proper APA citations where required. I also understand that quality work, reliability, and consistent communication are required.”



Additional Documents



Please also
 the following to:







Required documents:



• Resume or portfolio

• School diploma, front and back

• Transcript of Records, front and back



For nursing graduates, please also include if available:



• BSN diploma

• CHED verification of degree equivalency

• RN license copy



Qualified applicants may be invited for a phone interview.



Please read the full post carefully before asking questions already answered here.



Apply only if you are serious, studious, reliable, respectful, academically strong, and ready to complete quality work.
