title: SEO Strategy & Product Manager
description:
SEO Strategy & Product Manager

Role Overview



The SEO Strategy & Product Manager is responsible for supporting the SEO Lead by ensuring the agency's SEO strategies, frameworks, deliverables, and service offerings remain aligned with current search trends, algorithm updates, AI-driven search experiences, and industry best practices.



This role focuses on identifying the activities most likely to generate results, evaluating emerging opportunities, and ensuring SEO products, methodologies, and strategic frameworks continue to evolve alongside changes in Google Search, AI search, and the wider search landscape.



The successful candidate will act as the agency's SEO research, strategy, and product specialist, helping shape the future direction of SEO services while supporting the SEO Lead with strategic recommendations, innovation, and continuous improvement.



This is not a people management role. It is a strategic role focused on research, product development, quality assurance, and ensuring the agency remains ahead of industry changes.



Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy Development

Support the SEO Lead in developing and refining SEO strategies.

Develop frameworks for Local SEO, National SEO, E-commerce SEO, Technical SEO, GEO, AEO, Entity SEO, and Authority Building.

Review current methodologies and identify opportunities for improvement.

Ensure strategic recommendations remain aligned with current search engine requirements and industry best practices.

Assist with campaign planning and strategic direction where required.

Develop scalable SEO systems and frameworks that can be applied across multiple clients and industries.

SEO Product & Package Ownership

Review and improve SEO packages on an ongoing basis.

Ensure deliverables remain relevant, effective, and focused on measurable outcomes.

Identify opportunities to improve service offerings and client results.

Recommend additions, removals, or adjustments to package inclusions.

Develop new products and service offerings in response to industry changes.

Ensure agency offerings remain competitive and future-focused.

Search, AI & Industry Research

Monitor Google algorithm updates and search industry developments.

Stay informed on developments across:

Google Search

AI Overviews

ChatGPT Search

Gemini

Perplexity

Claude

GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation)

AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation)

Entity SEO

Technical SEO

Research competitor offerings and emerging opportunities.

Translate industry developments into actionable recommendations.

Performance & Activity Evaluation

Assess whether current SEO activities are generating meaningful results.

Identify activities that should be expanded, improved, reduced, or removed.

Review performance trends and emerging opportunities.

Work closely with the SEO Lead to ensure recommendations are supported by data and performance insights.

Ensure SEO activities remain aligned with what is currently working within search.

Authority Building & Link Acquisition Strategy

Develop and maintain authority-building frameworks.

Review and improve link acquisition methodologies.

Research emerging authority signals and trust factors.

Identify opportunities for digital PR and authority growth.

Ensure link-building activities align with current search requirements and best practices.

SOP, Framework & Process Development

Develop and maintain SEO SOPs, templates, checklists, and strategic frameworks.

Ensure internal documentation reflects current best practices.

Create implementation guides for new initiatives and methodologies.

Support consistency, quality assurance, and scalability across SEO delivery.

Internal Education & Knowledge Sharing

Share industry developments and strategic recommendations with internal stakeholders.

Assist in educating the team on new search developments and opportunities.

Document key findings, frameworks, and recommendations.

Help ensure strategic knowledge is accessible and scalable across the business.

Key Deliverables

Monthly

SEO Trends & Industry Insights Report

Algorithm Update Summary

AI Search & GEO Update Report

Package & Deliverable Review

Strategic Recommendations Report

Authority Building & Link Acquisition Review

Quarterly

SEO Product & Package Audit

Strategic Framework Review

Competitor Analysis

SOP & Process Review

New Service & Opportunity Recommendations

SEO Innovation & Roadmap Report

Success Measures

SEO packages remain aligned with current search trends and best practices.

Strategic frameworks are regularly reviewed and improved.

New opportunities are proactively identified and implemented.

Recommendations contribute to improved client outcomes.

SEO offerings remain competitive and commercially viable.

The agency remains ahead of major industry shifts rather than reacting to them.

SEO activities remain focused on what drives measurable results.

Skills & Experience

Essential

Strong SEO strategy experience.

Deep understanding of Google Search and ranking factors.

Strong knowledge of Technical SEO, Content Strategy, Entity SEO, and Link Building.

Understanding of GEO, AEO, AI Search, and emerging search technologies.

Strong analytical and research skills.

Excellent communication and documentation abilities.

Ability to identify trends and convert them into actionable strategies.

Commercial awareness and product-thinking mindset.

Desirable

Experience developing SEO products or service offerings.

Experience reviewing agency SEO frameworks and deliverables.

Familiarity with AI search optimisation and entity-based search strategies.

Experience working within an agency environment.

Application Process



As part of the recruitment process, shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a practical assessment and submit a Loom presentation.



SEO Strategy & Product Review Assessment



Candidates will prepare a 10-15 minute Loom presentation covering:



Future of Search

Key SEO developments expected over the next 12-24 months.

The impact of AI Search, GEO, AEO, Entity SEO, Technical SEO, and Authority Building.

SEO Product & Package Recommendations

Activities agencies should be prioritising.

Activities becoming less valuable.

What a modern SEO package should include.

New services or opportunities worth introducing.

Strategy & Innovation

How SEO offerings should evolve over time.

How algorithm changes and AI search developments should influence strategy.

How to evaluate whether SEO activities remain effective.

Authority Building

Recommended approach to authority building, link acquisition, entity development, digital PR, and trust signals.

90-Day Action Plan

What you would review first.

What improvements you would prioritise.

What recommendations you would make during your first 90 days.

Assessment Criteria



Candidates will be assessed on:



SEO strategy knowledge

Understanding of AI search and emerging trends

Strategic thinking

Commercial awareness

Product development capability

Problem-solving skills

Communication and presentation skills

Ability to translate research into practical recommendations

Mission of the Role



To ensure SEO strategies, deliverables, frameworks, and service offerings continuously evolve with search engine algorithms, AI search platforms, and industry best practices, helping the agency deliver the activities most likely to generate sustainable rankings, traffic, authority, and business growth for clients.

title: Experienced DMCA & Copyright Infringement VA
description:
We’re looking for an experienced Virtual Assistant to help us identify, document, and remove copyright infringements across the web.



This role is only for someone who already has hands-on experience with DMCA takedowns, copyright enforcement, platform reporting, and infringement documentation. Please do not apply if you are new to this type of work.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



Finding unauthorized copies of our copyrighted content, products, images, videos, landing pages, ads, PDFs, courses, and digital assets

Monitoring websites, marketplaces, social platforms, ad libraries, search engines, and file-sharing platforms for infringements

Documenting infringements with clear evidence, including URLs, screenshots, dates, account names, and platform details

Preparing and submitting DMCA takedown notices

Filing copyright infringement reports on platforms 

Following up on submitted claims until the infringing content is removed

Tracking all cases in a spreadsheet or project management tool

Escalating repeat offenders or more complex cases when needed

Creating repeatable SOPs for our copyright enforcement process



Requirements



You must have:



Proven experience handling DMCA takedowns and copyright infringement reports

Experience identifying infringing websites, ads, social media posts, stores, videos, product listings, or digital downloads

Knowledge of how to find hosting providers, domain registrars, website owners, platform abuse contacts, and relevant reporting forms

Strong attention to detail when collecting evidence

Ability to write clear, professional takedown notices

Experience keeping organized case logs and follow-up systems

Strong English writing skills

Ability to work independently and move cases forward without hand-holding



Experience with any of the following is a big plus:



Ecommerce brand protection

Course piracy removal

Counterfeit product listings

Ad copy / creative theft

Reverse image search tools

Google deindexing requests

WHOIS / DNS lookup tools

Hosting provider abuse reports

Brand protection tools or workflows

Important



This is not a beginner role.



We are not looking for someone who wants to “learn DMCA.” We need someone who has already done this work before and can show examples of previous copyright enforcement, takedown, or brand protection experience.

title: QA Manager
description:
WE’RE HIRING! JOIN OUR TEAM!



Position: QA Manager

Company: Baton (
)

Location: 100% Remote (WFH)

Work Hours: Mountain Standard Time

Rate/Salary: $8-10 per hour



About the Role



Baton is seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented QA Manager to oversee quality assurance, compliance, buyer performance, and traffic quality across our call marketplace.



This role is responsible for monitoring call quality, publisher compliance, buyer performance, refund trends, and operational risks to ensure the marketplace maintains high standards of quality and accountability. The QA Manager will proactively identify issues, investigate root causes, and work cross-functionally with Publisher Management, Client Success, Operations, Sales, and Leadership to improve conversion outcomes, reduce preventable credits, and strengthen partner performance.



This is a highly visible role that combines quality assurance, compliance oversight, reporting, operational analysis, and process improvement.



Key Responsibilities



Credit & Refund Oversight

- Monitor credit and refund trends by buyer, campaign, publisher, sub-ID, and category.

- Identify recurring fail reasons, unusual approval rates, and emerging patterns.

- Investigate whether issues originate from traffic quality or buyer-side operational failures.

- Flag buyers with excessive refund requests or abnormal credit behavior.

- Develop recurring reports highlighting refund drivers and trends.

- Recommend corrective actions including routing adjustments, bid changes, publisher feedback, buyer coaching, and traffic filtering improvements.



Call Quality Assurance

- Review call recordings, transcripts, and call outcomes on a daily and weekly basis.

- Evaluate transfer quality, buyer call handling, and overall caller experience.

- Review AI-assisted call interactions where applicable.

- Identify fraud, coached callers, low-intent leads, wrong-service inquiries, compliance concerns, and other quality issues.

- Maintain a library of common quality issues, examples, and training materials.



Buyer Performance Monitoring

- Track buyer answer rates, connection rates, call handling effectiveness, and responsiveness.

- Identify buyers missing calls, creating poor caller experiences, or generating avoidable credits.

- Analyze operational issues impacting conversion performance.

- Surface trends by buyer, region, and campaign.

- Escalate performance concerns to Sales, Client Success, Operations, and Leadership teams.

- Support initiatives that improve buyer accountability and service levels.



Compliance Management

- Maintain publisher compliance records and documentation.

- Ensure required certifications, disclosures, traffic source information, and supporting materials are current and complete.

- Monitor renewal and recertification requirements.

- Review landing pages, disclaimers, and traffic source declarations for compliance.

- Investigate TCPA-related concerns and other compliance alerts.

- Escalate high-risk publishers or traffic sources when necessary.

- Maintain audit-ready compliance documentation.



Alert Monitoring & Investigation

- Monitor alerts related to fraud, TCPA risk, answer-rate issues, abnormal call behavior, and - refund spikes.

- Conduct root cause investigations and document findings.

- Recommend and track corrective actions.

- Collaborate with internal stakeholders to resolve recurring issues.



Reporting & Trend Analysis

- Develop and maintain QA scorecards and performance dashboards.

- Create recurring reports for leadership on:

- Traffic quality

- Buyer performance

- Refund trends

- Compliance risk

- Operational performance

- Translate data into actionable recommendations.

- Measure the effectiveness of implemented solutions over time.



SOP Ownership & Process Improvement

- Create, document, and maintain standard operating procedures for:

- Call reviews

- Compliance reviews

- Refund investigations

- Escalation management

- Quality assurance processes

- Standardize QA definitions, audit criteria, and review methodologies.

- Improve workflows between QA, Publisher Management, Sales, Client Success, and Operations.

- Assist with training and coaching around recurring quality and compliance issues.



Escalation Management

- Serve as the primary point of contact for quality and compliance escalations.

- Route issues to the appropriate teams and stakeholders.

- Track investigations through resolution.

- Identify systemic issues and implement long-term solutions.



Additional Responsibilities

- Audit call disposition accuracy and consistency.

- Review category mapping and call routing logic.

- Monitor buyer coverage failures and no-answer trends.

- Support dispute resolution through call reviews and documentation.

- Maintain training examples of approved versus non-approved traffic.

- Partner with Data and Engineering teams to improve dashboards, alerts, and reporting.

- Help establish thresholds for buyer warnings, pauses, and escalations.



Qualifications



Required

- 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, Compliance, Operations, Call Center Management, - Lead Generation, Performance Marketing, or a related field.

- Strong analytical and investigative skills.

- Experience reviewing call recordings, transcripts, and performance data.

- Ability to identify trends and root causes across large datasets.

- Strong reporting and dashboard experience.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.

- Experience creating SOPs, documentation, and process improvements.



Preferred

- Experience in pay-per-call, lead generation, affiliate marketing, or call marketplaces.

- Familiarity with TCPA compliance and call tracking platforms.

- Experience working with publisher networks, buyers, and performance marketing ecosystems.

- Experience with AI-driven call handling or conversational AI platforms.

- Experience using CRM, BI, and reporting tools.



Success Metrics (KPIs)

- Accurate and timely delivery of credit and refund trend reporting.

- Percentage of active publishers reviewed monthly.

- Percentage of high-risk buyers audited monthly.

- Time to investigate and escalate quality concerns.

- Reduction in preventable credits and refunds.

- Reduction in buyer-side answer rate and connectivity issues.

- Reduction in invalid, misrouted, or wrong-category calls.

- Compliance documentation completion and audit readiness.

- Alert investigation and resolution rates.

- QA audit volume, quality, and turnaround time.



What Success Looks Like



The successful QA Manager will create visibility into marketplace quality, identify risks before they become costly problems, improve buyer and publisher accountability, strengthen compliance standards, and help Baton maximize revenue by reducing preventable credits and operational inefficiencies.

title: Ecommerce all round assistent
description:
E-commerce Product Researcher & Sourcing Specialist

Long-term | Full-time | Remote | 40 hrs/week





About the role



We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented E-commerce Product Researcher & Sourcing Specialist to join our team on a long-term, full-time basis. You will work with us every day to find new products, support our Shopify store, and research what our competitors are doing. You will follow clear internal processes (SOPs) so you always know exactly what is expected.



This is a long-term position. We are not looking for someone for a few weeks — we want to build something together over time.







What you will do



- Research and find new products based on our SOPs, looking at demand, pricing, and market fit

- Help with day-to-day tasks in our Shopify store: adding products, updating listings, managing the catalogue

- Carry out competitor research: monitor what other stores are selling, how they price their products, and what they are promoting

- Send us a clear daily report every working day with your findings and progress

- Keep track of trends on platforms like TikTok Shop, Amazon, and AliExpress to spot opportunities early

- Maintain organized research logs and sourcing records

- Proactively suggest new product ideas based on your research



---



Daily reporting



Every working day you will send a structured update covering your product research, competitor findings, and Shopify progress. We expect you to be responsive during working hours and to communicate clearly and consistently with the team. This is an important part of the role.



Requirements



- Available 40 hours per week, consistently

- Excellent English, both written and spoken

- Master's degree or higher

- Age between 25 and 35

- No children

- Stable and fast internet connection

- Organised, disciplined, and able to follow processes and meet daily deadlines

- Analytical mindset — comfortable working with data and spotting patterns

- Basic experience with Shopify or eager to learn quickly

- understanding of AI



Nice to have



- Experience in e-commerce product research or sourcing

- Familiarity with tools like Minea, Adspy, or Jungle Scout

- Knowledge of dropshipping or similar business models



Growth opportunities



We invest in the people we work with. As you prove yourself in this role, there is real opportunity to grow into a leadership position — managing and training a team of researchers who work under you. If you are ambitious and consistent, this role can grow significantly over time.



How to apply



Send your CV along with a short introduction — a voice note or short video is preferred. Tell us why you are a good fit, what experience you have with e-commerce or research, and what your daily availability looks like. Applications without a personal introduction will not be considered.



We are looking for someone who is ready to commit for the long term and grow with us.

mber

title: Billing & Collections Specialist (Accounts Receivable + QuickBooks)
description:
Job Title: Billing & Collections Specialist (Accounts Receivable + QuickBooks)

Salary: $1,400 to $1,600/month USD + performance bonuses

Type of Work: Full-time

English Level: Fluent

Hours per Week: 40, EST business hours (night shift in PH)

Skills / Keywords: Stripe, QuickBooks, accounts receivable, collections, bookkeeping, GoHighLevel, ClickUp, data entry



WHO WE ARE



RoofIgnite runs Meta advertising systems for roofing contractors doing $2.5M and up per year. We're a small, lean team that moves fast: founders, a Director of Ops, account managers, setters, and closers.



We do great work for our clients. The problem is on our side of the desk: billing happens late because nobody on the team has time to do it on schedule. Money we've earned sits uncollected. That's wrecking our cash flow, and we're done with it.



That's why this role exists. You fix it.



WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS



This is not an admin job. You own the money side of the business. You d
 that clients get billed on time, that failed payments get chased without flinching, and that overdue accounts actually get recovered. When you do this well, the whole company feels it.



We're giving one person real control over our cash flow. That takes trust, and it takes someone who treats other people's money like it's their own. If that sounds like pressure, it is. If it sounds like the kind of responsibility you've been waiting for, keep reading.



This is an urgent hire. We want someone starting immediately.





WHAT YOU'LL OWN



CORE (this is the heart of the job):



Stripe Billing

Manually create and send charges in Stripe the 
nt the team notifies you. Roughly 60 to 70 bills a month, backend payments averaging $3,500 to $5,000, some larger. You own the billing calendar so nothing slips. On-time collection is priority number one.



Collections

Build and run the failed-payment workflow. The escalation ladder: reminder, firm follow-up, call, flag to leadership for a service pause, final notice. You send and chase from a dedicated 
 address, and you'll
 and call clients (US roofing contractors) directly.



Bad Debt Recovery

Recover overdue accounts. A "bad debt" is a client who has missed a full billing cycle or is 14 or more days past due with no response. You go get it.



AR Reporting

Report regularly on late-payment cycles, at-risk revenue, and recovered debt, so leadership always knows where the money stands. There's real money on the line here every month, and it's your job to protect it.





SECONDARY (steady, but not the main event):



QuickBooks

Categorize expenses. The rules and SOPs already exist and most transactions auto-route. You handle the uncategorized ones and send edge cases for approval. Roughly 500 to 600 transactions a month. You're running the system, not building it.



Data QA

Audit our B2B Sales Tracker and client check-in system (both in Google Sheets) for missing or incomplete data, then go find the right data and fill the gaps. Example: a lead marked "set and confirmed" but the "setter qualified" field is blank. You flag it and fix it.



Sales / Marketing Data Watch

Keep an eye on key sales and marketing numbers and flag anything that looks off to the team.





OCCASIONAL:



HR Onboarding

Occasionally onboard new hires in BambooHR. Low frequency, as needed.





You'll work closely with leadership throughout. When a client needs their service paused for non-payment, you flag our CEO (Oscar), who directs the account managers. You're the one who sees the problem coming and raises the flag.





WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Stripe and QuickBooks: real, hands-on experience. Not "familiar with." You've actually run billing and bookkeeping in these tools.

- 2 or more years in accounts receivable, bookkeeping, or collections.

- Fluent English, written and spoken. You'll represent RoofIgnite to US clients over
 and phone, so both matter.

- Strongly preferred: ClickUp, GoHighLevel, BambooHR, Google Sheets.



THE PART MOST PEOPLE GET WRONG:



This role needs two things that rarely live in the same person: elite attention to detail AND the backbone to chase money without flinching.



Most applicants have one. The detail people are often too soft to push a late payer. The pushy people miss the small errors that make an invoice wrong. We need both in one person. If you're missing either, this isn't your role, and that's okay.





PAY AND BONUSES



Base is $1,400 to $1,600 USD per month depending on experience. On top of that, you earn performance bonuses tied to things like bad debt recovered, on-time collection, and data accuracy. Do the job well and you make more. Simple as that.





THE SCREENING TEST (REQUIRED)



Before you apply, open the billing accuracy check here and complete it:







This is a real test of the work you'd do every day. Completing it is required, not optional.



To apply, start your application with the word INVOICE so we know you read this whole post.



Any application that skips the test, skips the INVOICE keyword, or doesn't include a recording will not be considered for an interview. This is a hard gate.





HOW TO APPLY



A recording is mandatory. Submit either a Loom video (strongly preferred) or a Vocaroo voice recording (
).



In your recording, cover:



1. Your name and location.

2. Your AR, billing, and collections experience.

3. The tools you've actually used.

4. Your spoken answers to the three questions inside the test:

   - Which rows have an incorrect Total Charged, and the correct amount for each.

   - What went wrong in each case (a fee applied when it shouldn't be, a fee missing, or the ad spend math).

   - What you'd do before sending the invoice.



Applicants who complete the test correctly and submit a recording are the only ones we'll consider for an interview. No recording, no interview.



The recording is also how we screen English fluency and personality for a client-facing collections role, so speak clearly and naturally. Be yourself.

title: Sales Caller (Dialer) Pay: $1,200 USD guaranteed base
description:
TL;DR



Role: Sales Caller (Dialer) Pay: $1,200 USD guaranteed base. Plus bonuses you can earn every single day for hitting your targets. Schedule: You must work from 6:00 AM to 3:00 PM GMT+8 every day, but weekends we have lesser traffic. Client Revenue: The business makes $270,000 USD per month. Job: You call 100s of people a day. You are fast. You are diligent. Tracking: We do not screenshot your computer. We only care about your results. Requirement: You must send a voice note or video to apply.



JOB TITLE: HIGH-VOLUME SALES CALLER



WHAT IS THIS JOB? (READ THIS FIRST)



We are an education company. We sell a program that teaches people how to start online businesses. The program costs $5,000.



Our company makes $270,000 USD every month. We have too many people asking for help and not enough people to call them.



We need a "Dialer." Your job is to call these people on the phone. You are the engine. You call them fast. You make sure they are real. You help them buy our small $7 course if they cannot afford the big one.



WHO YOU ARE



• Experience: You do not need experience in this specific industry. You just need a proven history of being diligent (hard-working). • Fast & Punctual: You are always on time. You move fast. • Open To Learn: You listen to feedback and get better every day. • Tech: You have fast internet and a quiet room.



THE WORK CULTURE



We do not treat you like a baby.



We do not track your hours. We do not record your screen.



All we care about is: How fast did you call? And what happened on the call?



Every day you work is paid. If you need to take a leave, that is paid too. Everything is paid.



But it runs both ways. If you take excessive leaves for no real reason and become unreliable, we cannot keep working with you. We treat you like an adult. Act like one.



THE SCHEDULE



6:00 AM to 3:00 PM GMT+8.



This is non-negotiable. This is when our customers pick up the phone.



WHAT YOU WILL DO (THE DAILY WORK)



• Call Fast: When a new person signs up, you call them within 5 minutes. • Call A Lot: You will dial the phone 100 to 300 times a day. Most calls are short. • Sell The Small Stuff: If someone cannot afford $5,000, you sell them our $7 course. You do not let them leave with nothing. • Check In: You call students on Day 3 and Day 6 of their course to see if they are doing the work.



THE RULES (NO EXCUSES)

title: Sales Manager
description:
Sales Operations Manager / AI Sales Performance Manager

About Cynergists

Cynergists provides advanced AI Agents designed to help businesses automate workflows, increase productivity, and unlock scalable growth. We do not just fill seats. We deploy intelligent operations.

We are building the future of AI-powered business growth through agentic CRM systems, AI Workforce Agents, sales automation, lead generation, and intelligent follow-up systems. Our mission is to help small and mid-sized businesses scale like giants without needing bloated internal teams.

The Role

We are looking for a highly organized, assertive, and tech-curious Sales Operations Manager to help lead and manage our growing sales team.

This is not a traditional sales manager role where you are expected to personally close every deal. Your main responsibility is to make sure the sales team is executing every day, following the process, using the CRM correctly, improving from AI-generated feedback, and moving opportunities through the pipeline.

You will work directly inside the Cynergists CRM and with our AI Sales Trainer to monitor sales activity, review call performance, track follow-ups, identify stuck deals, and help each sales representative improve. The right person is calm under pressure, strong with details, comfortable holding people accountable, and excited about using AI to improve sales performance.

Our uploaded sales role template emphasizes diagnostic selling, pipeline management, AI sales training, CRM usage, and market feedback as core responsibilities for Cynergists sales positions . This manager role builds on that foundation but focuses on leading the team and making sure the sales system runs properly.



Key Responsibilities

Sales Team Accountability

Manage daily sales activity across the team, including calls, texts,
s, booked appointments, follow-ups, and pipeline movement.

Ensure every sales representative is following the required sales process, completing assigned outreach, updating the CRM, and staying on top of their opportunities.

Run daily or weekly check-ins with sales reps to review activity, performance, challenges, and next steps.

Hold reps accountable when activity drops, follow-ups are missed, or pipeline records are incomplete.

CRM and Pipeline Management

Monitor the Cynergists CRM to ensure leads, contacts, opportunities, notes, tasks, and deal stages are updated correctly.

Identify stale opportunities, missing follow-ups, incomplete contact records, and deals with no next step.

Make sure every active prospect has a clear next action assigned.

Track the full pipeline from first conversation to booked appointment, proposal, close, or lost deal.

AI Sales Coaching and Performance Review

Use Cynergists’ AI Sales Trainer and call scoring tools to review sales rep performance.

Monitor call scores, conversation quality, objection handling, buyer sentiment, follow-up quality, and close attempts.

Help sales reps understand their AI-generated feedback and turn it into better sales behavior.

Identify patterns across the team, including weak openers, poor discovery, missed closes, pricing objections, or lack of urgency.

Sales Reporting

Prepare weekly sales performance reports for leadership.

Track key sales metrics, including:

Calls made

 Conversations started

 Appointments booked

 Show rate

 Follow-up completion

 Pipeline created

 Deals closed

 Close rate

 Average call score

 Rep-by-rep performance trends

Flag underperforming reps and recommend corrective action.

Sales Process Improvement

Help improve scripts, sales workflows, CRM automations, objection handling, and follow-up sequences.

Listen to feedback from business owners and sales reps to identify gaps in our offers, sales materials, or AI Agent catalog.

Relay market feedback to leadership and the development team so Cynergists can improve its products and sales process.

Training and Onboarding

Assist with onboarding new sales representatives.

Teach reps how to use the CRM, follow the sales process, review AI feedback, and manage their pipeline.

Help create simple SOPs, checklists, and training materials for the sales team.

Run roleplays and objection-handling practice when needed.



What We Are Looking For

Strong Accountability

You must be comfortable holding sales reps accountable. This role is not just admin support. You need to be able to say, “This was not completed,” “This follow-up was missed,” or “Your call score dropped and we need to fix it.”

Sales or Appointment Setting Experience

You do not need to be a world-class closer, but you should understand sales activity, follow-up, objections, CRM pipelines, and appointment setting.

Experience managing or supporting outbound sales teams is a major plus.

CRM Experience

Experience with Go High Level, HubSpot, Salesforce, Close, Pipedrive, or another CRM is preferred.

You must be comfortable learning software quickly and working inside dashboards every day.

Tech-Savvy Mindset

You do not need to be a developer, but you must be excited about AI, automation, and software.

You should be comfortable using AI tools to review performance, summarize activity, identify problems, and improve sales execution.

Organized and Detail-Oriented

You must be able to manage multiple reps, tasks, follow-ups, reports, and deadlines without letting things fall through the cracks.

Clear Communication

Strong written and verbal English communication is required.

You will communicate with sales reps, leadership, and occasionally other departments, so clarity matters.

Calm Under Pressure

Sales teams move fast. Leads get missed. Reps get frustrated. Deals stall.

We need someone who stays calm, solves problems, and keeps the team moving.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience managing appointment setters, sales reps, or virtual sales teams

 Experience working remotely

 Experience with Go High Level

 Experience with AI tools or sales automation

 Experience reviewing call recordings or sales performance

 Experience creating SOPs or training materials

 Experience working with U.S.-based companies

 Strong spreadsheet and reporting skills



Performance Expectations

Success in this role will be measured by:

Sales reps completing required daily activity

 CRM records staying clean and updated

 Follow-ups being completed on time

 Pipeline stages being accurate

 Improvement in rep call scores

 Increase in appointments booked

 Increase in close rate

 Reduction in missed leads and stalled deals

 Clear weekly reporting to leadership



Why Join Cynergists?

Work in the Future of AI Sales

You will be helping build and manage an AI-powered sales organization, not an outdated manual sales team.

Real Leadership Opportunity

As Cynergists grows, this role can become a larger leadership position managing more reps, more processes, and more revenue operations.

Remote Work

This is a remote position. You can work from your own space while supporting a fast-growing U.S.-based AI company.

AI-Powered Training and Support

You will have access to our AI Sales Trainer, CRM tools, call scoring, and internal systems to help you manage the team effectively.

Growth-Oriented Culture

We are building fast. The right person will have room to grow with the company.



Schedule

Full-time preferred.

Must be available during core U.S. business hours for sales team check-ins, reporting, and leadership communication.



Compensation

Competitive monthly compensation based on experience.

Performance bonuses may be available based on team sales activity, booked appointments, closed revenue, and CRM compliance.



To Apply

Submit your resume and a short cover letter explaining:

Why you would be a strong fit to manage a sales team

Your experience with CRM systems or sales operations

 Your experience holding people accountable

 Why you are interested in AI-powered sales

title: GoHighLevel Client Success Specialist - Full Time, Work From Home
description:
We are expanding and need a full-time GoHighLevel Client Success Specialist to help our clients get up and running, get the most from the platform, and resolve their day-to-day questions.



This is a permanent position. We're looking for someone who wants to stay with our company long term, work alongside our existing team (Filipinos and Australians), and continue to learn and upgrade their skills toward mastery.



This is a broad role. You'll be across the majority of GHL's functionality so you can help clients with whichever features matter to them, deliver training, resolve support requests, and carry out small build projects. You won't be the deepest technical specialist on the team (we have automation specialists and web/funnel designers for that), but you'll be the capable, client-facing all-rounder who keeps clients confident and moving forward.





## WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



* Deliver new client training via Zoom, walking clients through the features relevant to their business

* Assist with onboarding new clients, including supporting our onboarding specialist with the data migration process

* Handle client support requests, most of which you'll resolve by providing clear written how-to instructions, a Loom video, or a pre-recorded video from our user training library

* Escalate the small number of support requests that require GHL technical support, and track them through to resolution for the client

* Build simple funnels in functional terms - placing forms, buttons and other elements on pages and testing that everything works (our web designers handle the visual design, so you won't need design skills)

* Build simple workflows as part of client projects

* Implement small paid projects at the request of clients

* Communicate clearly and professionally with clients throughout, in both written and spoken English



On more complex projects, you'll have backup from our team to help with the more challenging tasks. You're never left alone with a hard problem.





## LEARNING AND GROWTH



You'll have the opportunity to deepen your GHL expertise and to work with AI tools as part of your role. We invest in our team's growth and provide training. If you enjoy learning and want to move toward mastery of the platform, you'll fit in well here.





## REQUIREMENTS



* 1-2 years of hands-on experience using GoHighLevel across a broad range of features (ideal)

* Previous client-facing work experience - for example customer support, customer success, account management, onboarding, or training. This is a requirement.

* Clear, confident written and spoken English, and comfort speaking with clients on Zoom with screen sharing

* A good working knowledge across most GHL functions: subaccounts, CRM and pipelines, forms, calendars, conversations, funnels, workflows and settings

* The ability to build simple funnels (functionally) and simple workflows

* A background in other IT work - such as networking, technical support, or another technical role - will be an advantage





## KEY PERSONAL QUALITIES



1. Client-focused and patient

2. "Can do" attitude

3. Takes initiative and is efficient

4. Strong problem solver who can work things out without hand-holding

5. High attention to detail

6. Reliable and consistent with communication and availability





## THE DETAILS



This is a full-time position, 40 hours per week. We pay the 13th month in December. We also provide time off in lieu if we need you to work outside your regular hours to meet a deadline. We will expect to be your only employment; we are not interested in people working for multiple clients or running side businesses.



We'd prefer that you work 8am - 4pm Philippines time, as this aligns with the business day here in Australia: 11am - 7pm Sydney time.



Salary: US$900 - US$1,100 per month, depending on experience.





## ABOUT US



We are Clientflow, an Australian GoHighLevel agency focussed on providing SaaS software to white collar services businesses, such as mortgage brokers, real estate services businesses, surveyors, education and training companies, and financial services businesses.



We operate at a higher level of technical competence than most other GoHighLevel agencies. We've built a reputation for technical excellence and outstanding customer service that we will expect you to continue. Because of our reputation, clients trust us to build very sophisticated solutions in GoHighLevel for them. Few HighLevel agencies tackle implementation projects as complex as the ones we routinely complete.





## APPLYING FOR THIS ROLE



Please detail how well your experience matches the requirements above when applying. Include any references that you have from previous employers for similar work, especially client-facing work.



After reviewing applications, we'll hold a short initial interview, followed by a technical skills assessment as a second step.



DO NOT use an AI tool to write your application for this role. We want to hear from you in entirely your own words.



Feel free to also ask any questions that you have about the role and the work involved.



NOTE: Do not contact us through other channels about this role. The only way to be considered for this position is to apply through this website (onlinejobs.ph).

The best ISAs don't pitch — they listen. They ask good questions. They make the homeowner feel understood before anything else happens. Your edge is empathy and urgency, not a script you're rushing through.





What You'll Be Doing

Inbound Lead Response



Every lead that comes in gets a call. Not in 5 minutes. Not "when you get a chance." Within 10 seconds of receipt — every time. Speed to lead is the standard. This is non-negotiable.



Follow-Up Cadence



Leads that don't pick up get worked. You'll follow a structured follow-up sequence — calls, texts, voi
s — until you get a conversation or the lead is officially dead. Nothing falls through the cracks.



Cold Calling



When you're not following up with existing leads, you're dialing cold lists. Lists are provided — your job is to work through them consistently, keep your energy up, and find the people who need what we offer.



Appointment Setting



The goal of every conversation is to understand the homeowner's situation and — if they're a fit — book them for an appointment with Jay. You qualify. Jay closes.



CRM Management



Every call, every outcome, every follow-up is logged in Follow Up Boss. You keep your pipeline clean and your notes sharp. No mystery leads, no ghost activity.



Daily Sales Check-In



Every day, we review your calls and your numbers together. This isn't a performance review — it's a feedback loop. We'll listen to calls, talk through what's working, and sharpen what isn't. The best ISAs get better every single week because they're coachable and they pay attention to the data.





How to Be a Hero

Meeting the standard gets you in the door. This is how you become someone we'd never let go.



You push past the first "no." Not with pressure — with genuine curiosity. You ask one more question, you dig one level deeper, and you find out if there's actually something there. Average ISAs hang up. Great ones turn a "not interested" into a 10-minute conversation.

You bring insights to the check-in. You're not just showing up with numbers. You're showing up with observations. "I noticed leads from this list are going cold faster — here's what I think is happening." You're thinking about the pipeline, not just dialing through it.

You find patterns before we do. Best time to call, which scripts are landing, which objections keep coming up — you're tracking it without being asked. You turn your call activity into intelligence we can actually use.

You make Jay look good in every handoff. When you book an appointment, Jay walks in with context. You've qualified the lead, you've logged the situation, and Jay isn't starting from zero. The handoff is seamless because you made it that way.

You get better every week. You listen back to your own calls. You apply feedback. You don't make the same mistake twice. The ISAs who thrive here are the ones who are always improving — not the ones who think they've already figured it out.





How to Drive Me Crazy

Going quiet after a call. Log it. Every time.

Letting leads sit. Speed to lead isn't a suggestion — it's the standard.

Winging follow-up. There's a cadence. Follow it.

Burning out and going silent. This is a high-volume role. If you're struggling, say something — don't just disappear.

Needing to be reminded. You own your pipeline. I shouldn't have to check your activity to find out what's happening.





Qualifications

Proven experience in phone sales, ISA work, or high-volume outreach — real estate experience is a plus, not a requirement.

Excellent spoken English — warm, clear, and professional.

Comfortable making a high volume of calls daily without losing energy or quality.

Experience with a CRM (Follow Up Boss preferred, but any CRM works).

Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional calling environment.

Full-time availability during US business hours (Eastern Time preferred).

Self-directed — you manage your own activity without constant check-ins.





Tools You'll Use

Follow Up Boss — CRM for lead tracking and follow-up management

GoHighLevel — CRM for lead tracking and follow-up management

Slack — async communication and daily check-ins

Dialer — provided or recommended based on setup





To Apply

Fill out the application here:
